title: Zindaan Main Nahin Athi, Kyu Tazzah Hawa Bhayah
body:
Sajaad Sakina Ko (x2) Maarnay Seh Bacha Bhayah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani Nahin Maangu Gi, Bacho Ko Sambhalu Gi
In Chotay Say Haato Seh, Teray Kaantay Nikalo Gi
Ek Baar Sakina Ko (x2)
Tu Paas Bhulwoh Bhayah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Deewaro Seh Zindaan Ki, Taak Rahkay Main Girr Thi Hu
Phir Dehr Talak Bahayh, Tanhayee Si Sisak Thi Hu
Ah Rayt Kay Bistaar Seh (x2)
Bhaynah Ko Uttah Bhayah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Nay Mujhay Maara Tah, Woh Khwaab Main Atha Hain
Mai Sooh Bhi Nahin Sakdhi, Kuch Aisay Dhaara Tah Hain
Sajaad Mujay Daydo (x2)
Bahoo Main Pannah Bhayah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jeethi Ti Imamat Ke, Mein Paak-e-Save Roway
Abh Meray Guzar Ti Hai, Zindaan Eh Indero Mein
Is Waqt Bhi Rasi Mein (x2)
Hai Mera Gala Bhayah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajaad Tere Ghaam Main, Jo Ashkh Bahayeh Gah
Jo Halqah-e-mataam Main, Saar Peetay Taahegah
Tauqeer Dilawogi (x2)
Wadah Hain Mera Bhayah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Karti Hai Behen Wada, Baba Ko Na Rowaygi
Ashko Se Kabhi Aapna, Damaan Bhi Na Gowaygi
In Goreh Indero Se (x2)
Karwan Eh Raha Bhayah
<<DIVIDER>>
Laila Te Te Sab Mujko, Jis Waqt Mein Roti Ti
Mein Saare Khabar Tumko, Jis Jaanpe Soti Thi
Aah Dekh Sakina Ko (x2)
Kya Haal Howa Bhayah
